title: Best Practices for Designing a Context Document
text: Use this page to capture practical guidance for creating clear, useful context documents that support responsible AI workflows for marine ecosystem modeling.

title: Best Practices for Designing a Context Document
text:
Suggested Main Points to Expand

Purpose and audience

Define what decisions the document supports and who will use it.

System and problem context

Describe ecological scope, model boundaries, assumptions, and constraints.

Data provenance and quality

Record data sources, collection methods, known limitations, and stewardship practices.

Model behavior and uncertainty

Explain expected performance, uncertainty drivers, and risk implications.

Ethical and governance considerations

Document potential impacts, stakeholder concerns, and accountability processes.

Update and review lifecycle

Specify versioning, ownership, review cadence, and triggers for updates.
